_about: Legend text the ENGINE rewrote, declared by the engine pull request that rewrote it (buses-data OA-607). gate_lib.js labelDiff() reads this file: a line lost from a rebuilt sheet is REWORDED rather than LOST only when (1) it is declared in `was` for that sheet, rebuilt whole from the lost fragments if the sheet wraps it; (2) every `now` line of the same entry is on the new sheet, so a declaration applies only once its rewording has happened; and (3) neither the line nor any of its fragments is a string in the map's own S4 data files, old run or new, so a place, road or landmark label can never be excused by a declaration, right or wrong. `was` and `now` hold the text as the generator writes it, before XML escaping. `now` is empty for a pure deletion. `sheets` names the sheet files the entry applies to. An engine PR that rewords text a generator writes adds one entry here (make-bus-leaflet/references/changing-the-engine.md).

rewordings.why: buses-data OA-282: the Frequent Key row says what frequent means rather than promising a wait.

was: The panel headed “Operators & services” says who runs it.
Names printed along a line are its main stops, not every stop.
A time under a destination is a typical whole journey, not a timetable.
rewordings.why: buses-data OA-437 and OA-443: the How to use this map panel draws the first three derived bullets, and these three are dropped with nothing in their place.
